plain: Monospace text (code, tokens, metric numbers) now renders in IBM Plex Mono instead of Geist Mono; import fonts.css (you already do since 0.21) and nothing else changes.

steps.plain: Your code names the font "Geist Mono" directly, and HDS no longer ships it, so that text falls back to the system monospace font; use var(--primitive-typography-family-mono) instead.
